agents.name: Wave Architecture Agent
agents.activities: Translate approved strategic waves into a proposed calendar, milestones, resource envelopes and provisioning timeline. Assess precedence, coupled applications and shared services. Expose infeasible dates rather than silently changing approved grouping.
agents.inputs: Pinned Phase 2 approved grouping, budget and constraints; Phase 3 released architecture and conditions; organizational calendar, capacity and environment lead-time evidence.
agents.outputs: Proposed wave calendar, milestones, capacity/budget assumptions, dependency groups, environment timeline and replan triggers.
agents.origin: Merge original Phase Planning A1 + Wave Planner A2
agents.contract_rule: Initial feasibility is provisional until detailed estimates, resources and tools reconcile. Calendar/resource assumptions need owners; material grouping/budget changes require upstream approval.
agents.merge_tuning: Initial feasibility is provisional until detailed estimates, resources and tools reconcile. Calendar/resource assumptions need owners; material grouping/budget changes require upstream approval.
agents.responsibility: Translate approved strategic waves into a proposed calendar, milestones, resource envelopes and provisioning timeline. Assess precedence, coupled applications and shared services. Expose infeasible dates rather than silently changing approved grouping.

agents.name: Wave Specification Agent
agents.activities: Specify component scope, task entry/exit obligations, environment readiness, data transfer/reconciliation/freeze and sync windows. Separate preparation, implementation, rehearsal and production cutover stages.
agents.inputs: A1 wave calendar; Phase 3 component/contract registry, data transition, recovery constraints and acceptance matrix; source dependency evidence.
agents.outputs: Per-wave specifications, component scope, data/environment plans, entry/exit requirements and inter-wave dependencies.
agents.contract_rule: These are execution plans, not executed migrations or provisioned environments. Any missing detailed acceptance or readiness evidence remains an explicit obligation.
agents.merge_tuning: These are execution plans, not executed migrations or provisioned environments. Any missing detailed acceptance or readiness evidence remains an explicit obligation.
agents.responsibility: Specify component scope, task entry/exit obligations, environment readiness, data transfer/reconciliation/freeze and sync windows. Separate preparation, implementation, rehearsal and production cutover stages.

agents.name: Task Generator Agent
agents.activities: Generate uniquely identified tasks with dependencies, owner role, estimates/ranges, acceptance links, phase/environment, deliverable and authority requirements. Publish one immutable task/context version for all five planners.
agents.inputs: A2 wave specification; pinned Phase 3 transition patterns, interface contracts, functional/NFR acceptance and recovery constraints; Phase 2 cost guardrails.
agents.outputs: Task DAG, task interpretation manifest, requirement/contract mapping, effort assumptions and phase ownership.
agents.contract_rule: Task dependencies must be acyclic or explicitly model coupled execution units. Phase 5/6/8/9 work remains separately scoped; Phase 7 is intentionally absent.
agents.merge_tuning: Task dependencies must be acyclic or explicitly model coupled execution units. Phase 5/6/8/9 work remains separately scoped; Phase 7 is intentionally absent.
agents.responsibility: Generate uniquely identified tasks with dependencies, owner role, estimates/ranges, acceptance links, phase/environment, deliverable and authority requirements. Publish one immutable task/context version for all five planners.

agents.name: Runbook Generator Agent
agents.activities: Draft ordered procedures, prerequisites, checkpoints, verification evidence, stop conditions, escalation and handover. Bind exact selected tools, roles, tests and recovery refs during controlled finalization after peer plans are available.
agents.inputs: A3 task/context manifest and A2 wave plans; Phase 3 transition/recovery constraints; stakeholder and communication policies.
agents.outputs: Draft then reconciled runbooks; notification matrix, blackout coordination, hypercare and step-to-task mapping.
agents.contract_rule: Parallel output may contain declared unresolved bindings. It cannot be released until A9 verifies exact tool/resource/test/recovery refs. No guessed commands, traffic percentages or runtime endpoints.
agents.merge_tuning: Parallel output may contain declared unresolved bindings. It cannot be released until A9 verifies exact tool/resource/test/recovery refs. No guessed commands, traffic percentages or runtime endpoints.
agents.responsibility: Draft ordered procedures, prerequisites, checkpoints, verification evidence, stop conditions, escalation and handover. Bind exact selected tools, roles, tests and recovery refs during controlled finalization after peer plans are available.

agents.name: Resource Planner Agent
agents.activities: Plan task/shift roles and shared-resource capacity, identify contention and coverage gaps. Reconcile selected-tool competence, access and procurement dependencies with A6 during finalization.
agents.inputs: A3 task estimates and role needs; A1 proposed calendar/envelopes; named availability, skills, time zones and support roster evidence.
agents.outputs: Proposed staffing, capacity schedule, role coverage, competency evidence, gaps and recruitment/training needs.
agents.contract_rule: Competence requirements derive from the task/tool and organizational policy; no universal certification mandate. Proposed staffing is not a confirmed commitment.
agents.merge_tuning: Competence requirements derive from the task/tool and organizational policy; no universal certification mandate. Proposed staffing is not a confirmed commitment.
agents.responsibility: Plan task/shift roles and shared-resource capacity, identify contention and coverage gaps. Reconcile selected-tool competence, access and procurement dependencies with A6 during finalization.

agents.name: Tool Selection Agent
agents.activities: Specify per-task tool versions, integrations, permissions, license availability, lead times and operator competence. Compare options and document compatibility validation needs.
agents.inputs: A3 task/context manifest; Phase 3 technology/BOM/contracts; approved tool policy, compatibility evidence, cost and procurement constraints.
agents.outputs: Tool-to-task mapping, version/compatibility matrix, licensing and lead-time constraints, operator and environment prerequisites.
agents.contract_rule: Selection does not establish purchase, installed availability or operational compatibility. Any substitution requires runbook/resource/validation impact review.
agents.merge_tuning: Selection does not establish purchase, installed availability or operational compatibility. Any substitution requires runbook/resource/validation impact review.
agents.responsibility: Specify per-task tool versions, integrations, permissions, license availability, lead times and operator competence. Compare options and document compatibility validation needs.

agents.name: Validation Planner Agent
agents.activities: Define measurable functional, business-journey, NFR, interface, data, security and operational tests. Include approved behavior changes, representative data, environment and workload, evidence location, owner and decision rules.
agents.inputs: A3 tasks; Phase 3 functional and NFR acceptance matrix, data/interface contracts and security criteria; Phase 1 risks; A2 exit obligations.
agents.outputs: Validation plan, requirement-to-test coverage, gate criteria, evidence requirements, rehearsal and exception process.
agents.contract_rule: Plans do not prove compliance or passing tests. Each gate traces to its relevant requirement, not necessarily an NFR. Missing required criteria block the affected release.
agents.merge_tuning: Plans do not prove compliance or passing tests. Each gate traces to its relevant requirement, not necessarily an NFR. Missing required criteria block the affected release.
agents.responsibility: Define measurable functional, business-journey, NFR, interface, data, security and operational tests. Include approved behavior changes, representative data, environment and workload, evidence location, owner and decision rules.

agents.name: Rollback & Contingency Planner Agent
agents.activities: Plan recovery for app, data, interfaces and infrastructure; identify irreversible steps and point of no return. Define triggers, decision owners, roll-forward alternatives, reconciliation, rehearsals, contingency and hypercare exit.
agents.inputs: A3 tasks; A2 data state and wave plan; Phase 3 recovery constraints and transition architecture; risks, budget and decision authority policy.
agents.outputs: Recovery procedures and limits, risk responses, decision/escalation matrix, contingency assumptions, rehearsal and hypercare criteria.
agents.contract_rule: A feature switch or traffic rollback does not undo committed data or external effects. Cross-plan thresholds and recovery timing must reconcile before release.
agents.merge_tuning: A feature switch or traffic rollback does not undo committed data or external effects. Cross-plan thresholds and recovery timing must reconcile before release.
agents.responsibility: Plan recovery for app, data, interfaces and infrastructure; identify irreversible steps and point of no return. Define triggers, decision owners, roll-forward alternatives, reconciliation, rehearsals, contingency and hypercare exit.

agents.name: Planning Validation & Handoff Agent
agents.activities: Validate cross-plan bindings, task/requirement coverage, schedule/resources/tools, procurement, budgets and recovery consistency. Assign unresolved changes to artifact owners and assemble a candidate handoff; repeat after approved revisions.
agents.inputs: G1 exact A1-A8 snapshot and context version; P2/P3 authority/conditions; governance and release criteria.
agents.outputs: Coverage/feasibility report, conflict register, candidate plan manifest, task routes, governance and downstream handoff.
agents.origin: Retain original Migration Planning Validation A10
agents.contract_rule: A9 does not silently repair producer artifacts or approve release. Evidence-backed findings replace uncalibrated confidence scores; G2 owns authorization.
agents.merge_tuning: A9 does not silently repair producer artifacts or approve release. Evidence-backed findings replace uncalibrated confidence scores; G2 owns authorization.
agents.responsibility: Validate cross-plan bindings, task/requirement coverage, schedule/resources/tools, procurement, budgets and recovery consistency. Assign unresolved changes to artifact owners and assemble a candidate handoff; repeat after approved revisions.

cross_feeds.sources: A7 gates + A8 recovery + A4 steps

A1.raw: waves[]; calendar; capacity_envelopes[]; budget_refs[]; environment_timeline[]; infeasibilities[]; replan_triggers[]
A1.rule: Initial feasibility is provisional until detailed estimates, resources and tools reconcile. Calendar/resource assumptions need owners; material grouping/budget changes require upstream approval.

A2.raw: wave_specs[]; component_scope[]; data_plan; environment_plan; entry_exit_criteria[]; interwave_constraints[]
A2.rule: These are execution plans, not executed migrations or provisioned environments. Any missing detailed acceptance or readiness evidence remains an explicit obligation.

A3.raw: tasks[]; dependency_edges[]; context_manifest; acceptance_links[]; estimate_assumptions[]; phase_routes[]
A3.rule: Task dependencies must be acyclic or explicitly model coupled execution units. Phase 5/6/8/9 work remains separately scoped; Phase 7 is intentionally absent.

A4.raw: runbooks[]; step_task_links[]; tool_bindings[]; role_bindings[]; gate_refs[]; recovery_refs[]; communications; hypercare
A4.rule: Parallel output may contain declared unresolved bindings. It cannot be released until A9 verifies exact tool/resource/test/recovery refs. No guessed commands, traffic percentages or runtime endpoints.

A5.raw: assignments[]; capacity_schedule[]; skill_evidence[]; access_needs[]; coverage_gaps[]; external_commitments[]
A5.rule: Competence requirements derive from the task/tool and organizational policy; no universal certification mandate. Proposed staffing is not a confirmed commitment.

A6.raw: tool_bindings[]; versions[]; compatibility_evidence[]; license_status[]; lead_times[]; operator_requirements[]
A6.rule: Selection does not establish purchase, installed availability or operational compatibility. Any substitution requires runbook/resource/validation impact review.

A7.raw: tests[]; requirement_coverage[]; gates[]; test_data_requirements[]; environment_needs[]; evidence_requirements[]
A7.rule: Plans do not prove compliance or passing tests. Each gate traces to its relevant requirement, not necessarily an NFR. Missing required criteria block the affected release.

A8.raw: recovery_plans[]; irreversible_steps[]; trigger_rules[]; decision_authorities[]; risk_responses[]; contingency; rehearsal_criteria[]
A8.rule: A feature switch or traffic rollback does not undo committed data or external effects. Cross-plan thresholds and recovery timing must reconcile before release.

A9.raw: validation_report; coverage; conflicts[]; candidate_manifest; handoffs[]; governance; revision_requests[]
A9.rule: A9 does not silently repair producer artifacts or approve release. Evidence-backed findings replace uncalibrated confidence scores; G2 owns authorization.

Identity and version.definition: schema_version=P4.planning.v3.0; artifact_id/version; phase_id=4; run_id; portfolio/app/cohort/wave IDs; producer; content_hash.
Identity and version.failure: Reject unsupported versions, duplicate IDs and modified hashes.

Input/context manifest.definition: Exact P2/P3 refs/authority, A3 context hash where applicable, input versions, policy version, conditions and scope.

Status / evidence.definition: COMPLETE/PARTIAL/NOT_ASSESSED/SKIPPED_APPROVED/FAILED; provenance, capture date, scope, evidence class, gaps and unresolved bindings.
Status / evidence.failure: COMPLETE means producer assessment complete, not plan accepted.

Audit metadata.definition: Tool/model/prompt/policy versions, attempts, checkpoints, timestamps, validation records and access classification; no secrets.

Task record.definition: task_id; app/component/wave IDs; phase/environment; deliverable; predecessor IDs; input_refs; role; estimate and basis; acceptance refs; authority needs; recovery/rehearsal refs; applicability.
Task record.failure: Reject missing IDs, invalid routing, cycles and orphan scope.

Runbook step.definition: step_id; task_id; preconditions; action specification; exact tool/version; role; expected result; evidence; gate; stop/recovery refs; authority; irreversible flag.
Runbook step.failure: Unbound required tool, role or recovery state prevents release.

Validation gate.definition: criterion_id/type; requirement_ref; threshold/approval state; workload/data/environment; method; evidence location; owner; decision rule; exception policy.
Validation gate.failure: No inferred passing result from planned test coverage.

Recovery record.definition: state assumptions; source of truth; irreversible point; trigger; decision authority/window; rollback/compensation/roll-forward route; reconciliation; rehearsal evidence required.
Recovery record.failure: Unrecoverable effects require explicit accepted constraints or HOLD.

G1 candidate manifest.definition: Exact A1-A8 refs, app/wave/task coverage, shared context, binding refs, known unresolved conflicts and manifest_hash.
G1 candidate manifest.failure: Snapshot may contain semantic findings but not missing/failed required artifacts.

G2 acceptance.definition: candidate_hash; HOLD/SCOPED_PREPARATION/READY_FOR_PREPARATION; authorized_by/time; task/environment scope; inherited conditions; accepted exceptions; future prerequisites.
G2 acceptance.failure: No model confidence score substitutes for approval.

Phase 5 handoff.definition: P4 version/hash; authorized app/task IDs; task registry; accepted runbook/resource/tool/gate/recovery refs; P2/P3 design refs; constraints; entry obligations; conditions; phase ownership register.
Phase 5 handoff.failure: Validate exact scope on intake; future-stage tasks remain gated.

Change request.definition: Finding, owner, proposed correction, affected task/artifact IDs, upstream impact, approvals, replacement versions and invalidated descendants.
Change request.failure: Republish and revalidate before new release.

run_controls.behavior: Validate P2.portfolio.v3.0 authorized scope and P3.architecture.v3.0 READY_FOR_PLANNING or CONDITIONAL_PLANNING, exact hashes, app/cohort IDs and conditions. HOLD cannot enter.
run_controls.failure: Conditional planning allows only explicitly listed actions.

run_controls.behavior: Treat approved Phase 2 grouping and constraints as baseline. Refine dates/capacity only within delegated tolerances; changes affecting disposition, cohort, budget or approved scope require Phase 2 decision and Phase 3 impact review.
run_controls.failure: No silent overwrite of strategy or architecture.

run_controls.behavior: Use explicit calendar/time zone, holidays, availability, shared resources and environment/procurement lead times. Detailed staffing and estimates can invalidate the initial A1 calendar.
run_controls.failure: Publish unresolved infeasibility; no fabricated dates or commitments.

run_controls.behavior: Require task_id, wave/app/component IDs, phase/environment, deliverable, dependencies, role, estimate basis, acceptance refs, input versions, permissions and recovery/rehearsal needs.
run_controls.failure: Every scoped requirement/component has a task or approved exclusion.

run_controls.behavior: Check unknown references, duplicate IDs, cycles, external predecessors and coupled units. Treat approval/availability as prerequisites, not implicit elapsed-time assumptions.
run_controls.failure: No schedule release with unresolved dependency cycles.

run_controls.behavior: All planners consume the same A3 context hash. Independent first passes publish candidates and unresolved peer bindings. Candidate completion is not final readiness.
run_controls.failure: No claimed independence for final cross-plan consistency.

run_controls.behavior: Compare tool versions, operator skills, permissions, shifts and license/procurement status by task_id. Record evidence and mismatches; certification only where policy or contract requires it.
run_controls.failure: Single reconciliation pass is not assumed sufficient.

run_controls.behavior: Each runbook step binds exact tool/resource versions, expected outputs, validation gate, recovery action and authority. Reconcile stop thresholds, irreversible actions, notifications and hypercare criteria.
run_controls.failure: Unresolved required bindings prevent release.

run_controls.behavior: Require A4-A8 candidates plus transitive A1-A3, matching context hash, complete scoped task coverage and resolved artifact references. FAILED or missing outcomes block assembly.
run_controls.failure: Known semantic conflicts remain visible for A9; snapshot is not acceptance.

run_controls.behavior: Validate bidirectional task/requirement coverage, tool/skill/role binding, capacity/calendar, cost/contingency, environment/license readiness, test/recovery feasibility and phase routing. Record checks and limitations.
run_controls.failure: Absence of a reported issue is not universal proof.

run_controls.behavior: A9/orchestrator issues change request with affected IDs, proposed owner and impacted descendants. Owners republish artifacts; G1 creates a new snapshot and A9 revalidates. Invalidate related approvals/handoffs.
run_controls.failure: No in-place mutation of a sealed package or same-run back edge.

run_controls.behavior: Configure attempt/time/token/revision budgets and escalation authority. Unresolved disputes remain HOLD; no infinite retry and no forced single-pass claim.
run_controls.failure: Budget exhaustion cannot silently waive a gate.

run_controls.behavior: Trace functional journeys, approved behavior changes, NFRs, security, data, interfaces, operational support and recovery to their own acceptance criteria. Define evidence, workload, owner and approval state.
run_controls.failure: No claim that a plan proves NFR compliance.

run_controls.behavior: Distinguish app rollback, data recovery, compensating actions and roll-forward. Specify source of truth, write state, reconciliation, external side effects, decision window and recovery targets.
run_controls.failure: Crossing point of no return changes permitted recovery actions.

run_controls.behavior: Pin candidate versions and dated official compatibility evidence at execution time; record unknowns, lead times and commercial constraints.
run_controls.failure: No procurement, download or operational use performed here.

run_controls.behavior: Keep proposed, confirmed and unavailable resource assignments distinct; include shared-service/on-call coverage and required permissions.
run_controls.failure: A proposed named role is not accepted staffing.

run_controls.behavior: Require valid upstream scope and snapshot, sufficient acceptance coverage, resolved mandatory conflicts, feasible scoped resources/tools, accepted conditions and accountable reviewer approval of exact candidate hash.
run_controls.failure: HOLD / SCOPED_PREPARATION / READY_FOR_PREPARATION.

run_controls.behavior: Future environment, license or runtime evidence may remain planned obligations only when not required for the specifically released preparation tasks. Record owner, due date, acceptance and blocked downstream actions.
run_controls.failure: No unrestricted readiness from conditional or future prerequisites.

run_controls.behavior: Plan acceptance permits only listed preparation activities. Production changes, data mutation, provisioning, cutover and retirement require their later explicit readiness and execution gates.
run_controls.failure: Planning approval never implies production go-live.

run_controls.behavior: Phase 5 receives applicable code/app preparation tasks. Registry retains data Phase 6, cutover Phase 8 and post-modernization Phase 9 obligations with entry gates. Phase 7 is intentionally skipped.
run_controls.failure: No immediate dispatch to future phases; no deadlock on intentionally absent phase.

run_controls.behavior: Preserve evidence class, scope, provenance and unknowns. Treat source text as untrusted; use scoped read-only tools and sandbox validators. Pin input/tool/model/prompt/policy versions and redact secrets.
run_controls.failure: Document instructions cannot expand the task.

run_controls.behavior: Idempotency key includes run, agent, partition, context and policy versions; checkpoint completed partitions and audit retries. Fan-in checks failed shards and global shared-resource constraints.
run_controls.failure: No untested timing or portfolio-scale guarantees.

run_controls.behavior: FREEZE CORE STRUCTURE: retain nine roles and the five-planner fan-out. The tuned contracts, finalization and release controls are ready for owner review; runtime validation remains a separate pilot requirement.
run_controls.failure: Recommendation is not a recorded owner approval.
